name: Boundary condition uses strict > instead of >=
modeled_on: An eligibility check uses `age > 18` where the spec is `age >= 18` — an off-by-one in a comparison rather than an index. Real-world analogue: policy logic where the boundary value itself must be included.
hidden_bug: is_adult() uses a strict greater-than, so a user exactly at the boundary (18) is incorrectly rejected.
expected_behavior: is_adult(18) must return True; the boundary age must be included.
ground_truth: Change the comparison to `age >= 18` so the boundary value is included.

expected_patch.description: use >= instead of > at the boundary
